baseline.scope: Reproduced duplicate first-page requests, discarded cursor/page during failed refresh/preparation, stale deleted-user cache and skipped membership replacement.

historyState.scope: Before later explicit audit cursor and UI-fixture changes; rerun required for final source.

serverBaseline.scope: Legacy regional profile omitted: aggregate 69 vs directory 68.

server.scope: Actual handler + Auth/Firestore emulators: 137+ profiles, legacy-date coverage/paging, role matrix, reviewed CAS/idempotency/session revocation, sanctions/restore/expiry/target notifications, mocked push recipient token isolation, presence.

existingActionWindows.scope: Normal-size existing owner-protected detail and opening/cancelling four account-action forms; before new transfer-sheet fixture.

productionRead.scope: IAM aggregate/readback, not an owner-authenticated callable UI proof.

fullUnitRegression.scope: 851 passed, 30 opt-in SDK/live tests skipped; linked SDK checks are separate below.

connectedSanctions.scope: Actual client UI + SDK -> callable -> independent Firestore readback; warning/suspension/restore and fresh exact-recipient notices.

connectedRestrictions.scope: Actual client UI ban/deactivation/restore; exact stored state and fresh recipient notices.

connectedPlatformRoles.scope: Actual client UI administrator assign/remove, stored role+MFA flag, fresh recipient notices.

connectedOrganizationRoles.scope: Actual client UI moderator assignment/removal + independent organization fields and target notices.

connectedOwnership.scope: Actual client UI cancel preserves owner, confirm changes exact owner, both target and previous owner receive notices.

maximumRoleForms.scope: German dark maximum Dynamic Type: reach reason/action, empty disabled, input enabled, cancel, for platform and organization removal forms.

serverSearch1500.scope: Actual Firestore emulator, 1500 accounts, indexed/fallback equivalence, bounded return, selective candidate read, legacy callable permissions and event maintenance.

serverOrganizationPolicy.scope: Actual handlers, 1080 released-client capability decisions, stale edit/revoked role/replay.

serverFinalMatrix.scope: Fresh namespace, actual organizational memberships in authorization matrix.

deployment.scope: Exact deployed source, onDeployUpdatePolicy, cold unauthenticated rejection; owner-authorized device call still pending.

physicalRead.scope: Signed Release, real Serlest production session; initial directory, Serlest search, own protected card, presence/security; no mutation. Count badge discrepancy found in reviewed capture and fixed locally; final reinstall/readback pending.

finalUnits.scope: Complete Swift unit regression, including three linked-organization cache/interaction cases. Opt-in live/SDK cases are explicitly skipped and tracked separately.

historyFinal.scope: 45 records across 20-row pages, failed next page retains records and retries exact cursor.

guideRolesFinal.scope: Maximum German/dark role guide and app-admin controls; five organizational/member/warned profile visibility variants; slow load and retained search on return.

ownershipMaximum.scope: Maximum text, full target/reason confirmation, reachable action, cancel retains reason. No fixture mutation.

retryAndMaximum.scope: Initial directory and detail failure/retry; stale detail actions disabled; one error banner; maximum warning reason and suspension duration forms.

loadingFinal.scope: Stable navigation frame, loading and retained search; error does not continue claiming an active search; successful retry enables reviewed actions.

restrictedRecipient.scope: Actual isolated client sign-in sees exact owner restriction reason; no global user management; actual UI restoration independently read back.

organizationAdminSDK.scope: Actual client/SDK administrator assignment and removal, exact organization array and fresh target notices.

noticeDestination.scope: Actual target sign-in -> matching inbox record -> details -> exact related organization. Separate translated fixture fields synchronized before repeat.

linkedRepositorySDK.scope: Actual member Auth + repository reads exact owned organization within 10 seconds. Initial raw-name assertion; localized-name verification is supplied by noticeDestination.

linkedBaseline.scope: Expected failing baseline: one failed test with two assertions reproduced detail eviction and feed pollution.

linkedFixed.scope: Original race regression fixed, before two extra cache/interaction tests in finalUnits.

physicalFinal.scope: Signed Release, real Serlest production session; counts 67/40, scoped search 2/2, exact independent count 9 organizations, actual online response, protected self, security metadata. No mutation. Final wording-only copy is rebuilt separately.

serverAllSorts.scope: 137 profiles across all four complete paged sorts; 41 equal-name/equal-timestamp records maintain identity order; legacy dates, role memberships and authorization, stale actor, retry receipts.

sourceReview.scope: Bounded paging/projections and no per-row presence reads; nine-region enum and server contract; shared form/busy/keyboard semantics; immutable reviews and exact organization revisions; global vs organizational authorization routes.

deployedOwnerRead.scope: Exact deployed TS and JS, onDeployUpdatePolicy, Cloud Run Ready and 100% traffic on manageuserdirectory-00004-vuq; actual owner-authorized list/search on physical Release.

finalDirectoryAndDeletedState.scope: Final a921224d: plain directory error/retry and deleted user card without mutation controls.

finalGates.physicalRead: passed; final wording-only reinstall bookkeeping pending
finalGates.testFlightDelivery: Delivered per subsequent user request: 1.2.1 (123), internal Beta Tester; does not close physical readback gate.
